Bug_Title: IJU: TestCase declares a bad suite method (IJU_BAD_SUITE_METHOD)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by declaring a suite method with the signature 'public TestSuite suite()' instead of the correct 'public static junit.framework.Test suite()' or 'public static junit.framework.TestSuite suite()'.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the'suite()' method on an instance of 'ExampleSuite'. Since the'suite()' method is incorrectly declared as 'public TestSuite suite()' instead of 'public static junit.framework.Test suite()' or 'public static junit.framework.TestSuite suite()', it causes a compilation error if not addressed, but in the context of running the test, it will fail due to the incorrect method signature.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results indicate that the test passed without any errors or exceptions. The suite method in the ExampleSuite class is incorrectly declared as 'public TestSuite suite()' instead of 'public static junit.framework.Test suite()' or 'public static junit.framework.TestSuite suite()'. However, the test case 'testShowBug' does not fail, and there is no indication from the test results that the incorrect declaration of the suite method caused any issues during the test execution.
